description: This Java class 'AccountNumberGenerator' provides functionality for generating account numbers for various financial entities such as clients, loans, savings accounts, and share accounts within the Fineract microfinance platform. It supports configurable account number length, optional randomization, prefix options based on entity attributes, and conflict checking.

classes.name: AccountNumberGenerator
classes.description: A component class responsible for generating account numbers for different entity types with support for prefixing, length configuration, randomization, and conflict avoidance within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Overloaded methods to generate account numbers for Client, Loan, SavingsAccount, and ShareAccount objects, each assembling a property map based on the entity's attributes.

methods.name: generateAccountNumber
methods.description: Core method that constructs the account number string based on configured length, randomization, prefixing options, and conflict checks.

methods.name: randomNumberGenerator
methods.description: Generates a random numeric string of specified length, avoiding zero-only strings.

methods.name: checkAccountNumberConflict
methods.description: Checks for existing accounts with the same account number to avoid duplication, query dependent on entity type.

methods.name: generatePrefix
methods.description: Creates a prefix string based on account number format settings and entity attributes, adjusting length accordingly.

methods.name: generateGroupAccountNumber
methods.description: Generates an account number for a Group entity, similar to client accounts but with Group-specific attributes.

methods.name: generateCenterAccountNumber
methods.description: Generates an account number for a Center entity, treated as a type of Group with specific prefixing.
